sections.heading: Jordan Bennett
sections.subheading: This page is locked. Change the colors, the words, the whole business — it updates the moment you ask, and only you can see it.

sections.heading: What this space can hold
sections.subheading: Ask the studio to turn this into a bakery, a portfolio, a restaurant, or anything else.

items.title: A private homepage
items.body: The whole site asks for your password. Nobody else can open these pages.

items.title: A locked studio
items.body: Open /studio after you sign in. That is where you talk to the designer and save instantly.

items.title: Live customizations
items.body: Say “make it a coffee shop with ocean colors.” Your private site becomes that, right away.

sections.heading: Start with a sentence. Keep going from there.
sections.body: Replace this with your story. Name the business. Add photos, pricing, testimonials, a contact section — or wipe it and begin again. Only you see the latest version.

sections.heading: Say hello
sections.body: Add your email, phone, or city in the studio and this block will fill itself in.
